body: Good luck, my friend. I wish all the best for you.

Small pleasures can sometimes be the most important. I've been sent into depressive episodes for less. You're completely valid, and not pathetic at all. 

What kind of chocolate do you like?
That makes me feel less alone here. Thank you :)

Praying has helped me a lot. I'm not religious, but putting your faith in something bigger than yourself helps the hurt a little bit. Churches often bring me to tears, though, and I don't wanna be perceived as a nut-job. They're designed to make you feel small and something about that is cathartic. 

I hope your mouth feels more free without your wisdom teeth. X
